inlines.v: MU'TUAL, adjective [Latin mutuus, from muto, to change.] Reciprocal; interchanged , each acting in return or correspondence to the other; given and received. mutual love is that which is entertained by two persons each for the other; mutual advantage is that which is conferred by one person or another, and received by him in return. So we say, mutual assistance, mutual aversion. And, what should most excite a mutual flame, Your rural cares and pleasures are the same.
